title: Hitozuma kin'ryôku: Kutsu jokuteki na getsuyôbi
original_title: 人妻禁猟区 屈辱的な月曜日
overview: Maki, a housewife, receives news that her close friend Mayumi has passed away from cancer. While on her way to attend the memorial service marking the forty-ninth day after the death, she is confronted and threatened by Samejima—a former boss who was previously arrested for raping her...
